kit: Protocol Rebirth — Abandoned Town Enterable House Slice v0.4
origin: Ground contact at centre of footprint; walls start at floor level; props are centred on their footprint unless mounted by the game.
room_spec: 4 m clear interior square; 2.6 m wall height; front is -Z.

rendering.materials: Embedded flat base colours; no external textures or image files.
rendering.geometry: Low-poly box-based meshes with hard normals.
rendering.draw_calls: One primitive/material per asset; repeated wall/furniture assets share loader-cached geometry and materials.
rendering.target: Small mobile-first scene; full kit is under 170 KB as GLB.

palette: Warm plaster, timber browns, weathered teal fabric, muted metal and small amber/red interaction accents; intended to sit with the existing abandoned-town lighting.

assets.placement_notes: Low-profile slab, individually planked in the existing warm wood palette.
Plaster wall with dark exposed uprights, crown trim and baseboard.
Centred 1.24 m game opening kept clear; visible timber jambs and lintel.
Centred 1.2 m x 1.0 m opening; sill at .95 m; inset dark glass and timber frame.
Panelled timber leaf with a small metal latch; front faces -Z.
Panelled leaf rotated 90 degrees for the existing open-door placement.
Separate removable cap with shallow slate strips and raised timber edge.
Timber tabletop, apron and four legs.
Low two-seat sofa with distinct cushion and back colours.
Single bed with timber frame, mattress, blanket and pillow.
Cabinet front, handles and ceramic top.
Muted metal body with inset door and handle.
Four shelves with coloured low-poly book spines.
Timber crate with metal bands and a readable gold latch.
Wall cabinet with a simple red medical cross.
